info.name: MediFlow API
info.description:
MediFlow Patient Management System - API collection.

## Setup
1. Start infra: `docker compose up -d` (PostgreSQL + Kafka)
2. Start services with the `seed` profile to load demo users/patients/doctors:
   `mvn -pl backend/auth-service spring-boot:run` (and the other services; the `seed` profile is activated via `SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=dev,seed` or your local convention).
3. Import `MediFlow.postman_environment.json`, select the `MediFlow Local` environment.
4. Run `Auth -> Login (ADMIN)`, `Login (DOCTOR)`, `Login (PATIENT)` once - they auto-store tokens in `adminToken`, `doctorToken`, `patientToken`.

## Demo users (seed profile)
| Role | Username | Password | Token variable |
|---|---|---|---|
| ADMIN | `admin` | `Admin@123` | `{{adminToken}}` |
| DOCTOR | `doctor` | `Doctor@123` | `{{doctorToken}}` |
| PATIENT | `patient` | `Patient@123` | `{{patientToken}}` |

## Notes
- All URLs route through the API gateway (`{{gatewayUrl}}`, port 8080).
- Auth is JWT bearer; every protected request carries `Authorization: Bearer {{...Token}}`.
- Login/register/refresh scripts auto-capture `accessToken` + `refreshToken`.
